title: A Geometrical Design Tool for Building Cost-Effective Layout-Aware n-Bit Quantum Gates Using the Bloch Sphere Approach
summary: The conventional design technique of any n-bit quantum gate is mainly achieved using unitary matrices multiplication, where n >= 2 and 1 <= m <= n-1 for m target qubits and n-m control qubits. These matrices represent quantum rotations by an n-bit quantum gate. For a quantum designer, such a conventional technique requires extensive computational time and effort, which may generate an n-bit quantum gate with a too high quantum cost.
